mapper.select: SELECT dish_id AS dishId, MAX(dish_name) AS dishName, SUM(quantity) AS quantity, SUM(amount) AS amount FROM dish_sales WHERE stall_id = #{stallId} AND sale_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY dish_id ORDER BY quantity DESC
